color.note: Near-black with two faint glows (warm top-left, orange bottom-right), liquid-glass panes with a light rim, and orange as the one strong brand color. 16 muted manager colors identify people.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Always under the two glows, bg-glow-tl and bg-glow-br.

tokens.name: bg-glow-tl
tokens.usage: Faint warm glow: a very large soft radial from the top-left corner, about 7%. One of exactly two glows.

tokens.name: bg-glow-br
tokens.usage: Faint orange glow: a very large soft radial from the bottom-right corner, about 9%. One of exactly two glows.

tokens.name: pane
tokens.usage: Liquid glass panes: the sidebar, cards, panels, draft cells. With backdrop-filter blur-md and a pane-edge border.

tokens.name: pane-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered pane, selected nav item, hovered table row.

tokens.name: pane-dense
tokens.usage: Denser glass for data-heavy surfaces (the draft pool table, stat tables, the Members list) so text stays crisp over the glows. Same rim and blur as pane.

tokens.name: pane-edge
tokens.usage: 1px border on every pane. Decorative, not a control border.

tokens.name: pane-highlight
tokens.usage: Liquid-glass rim light: the top-left end of a pane's 1px gradient border (pane-highlight → pane-edge → transparent at the bottom-right), and the 1px inset highlight along a pane's top edge.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, empty draft cells) and table dividers. ≥ 3:1 on bg and pane.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg and panes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: team names, counts, column headers, metadata. ≥ 6.5:1 on bg and panes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The brand orange, used with conviction: primary buttons, the active nav item's icon, status badges for Live and Drafting, progress bars, the on-the-clock state, focus ring, links.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (7:1). White on orange fails contrast, so never use it.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange text on bg or panes, such as links and highlighted numbers (≥ 8:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted orange surface: the selected nav item background, hovered primary chip, the on-the-clock cell fill.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Negative points and errors. Always with a − sign or an icon.

tokens.name: neutral-badge
tokens.usage: Fill for Upcoming and Ended status badges (ink text).

tokens.name: manager-red
tokens.usage: Manager color (light red). One of 16; each manager in a tournament has a different one. Shows as the avatar ring and a 1px rim plus a faint tint on that manager's draft cells and roster card. Never a solid fill behind text.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Geist for everything. Weight and size carry the hierarchy, not extra fonts.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Team names and the little running text there is.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Player handles, manager names, nav items.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Rating, ACS, K/D and per-match points in tables and cells.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and badges, between stat chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between cards in a grid, between nav items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and pane padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between page sections; page gutter beside the sidebar.

radius.note: Soft, rounded panes; pills only for badges, avatars and swatches.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, stat chips, draft cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The sidebar pane, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status badges, avatars, color swatches.

shadow.note: Panes float a little; glow marks the active turn.

tokens.name: shadow-pane
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the sidebar.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The on-the-clock cell and the current manager's avatar.

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: Panes and cards.

tokens.name: blur-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and menus.

glass.note: Liquid-lens parameters for the SVG refraction filter (Chromium) and the grain overlay. Unitless numbers unless noted.

tokens.name: grain-opacity
tokens.usage: Opacity of a tiled SVG fractal-noise overlay on every pane and on the background. Kills banding in the glows and gives the glass a physical, frosted texture.

tokens.name: lens-bezel
tokens.usage: Width of the refracting rim of a liquid lens. The surface profile is a convex squircle, y = (1 − (1 − x)^4)^(1/4), for a smooth, thin-looking bezel.

tokens.name: lens-scale
tokens.usage: feDisplacementMap scale (max displacement in px) for liquid lenses. Animate it from 0 to fade the effect in.

tokens.name: lens-chroma
tokens.usage: Strength of the chromatic fringe at a lens edge: R and B offset by about 1px × this factor.

tokens.name: lens-specular-angle
tokens.usage: Light direction in degrees for the rim specular highlight. It's the same light for every lens, so all the glass looks lit from one place (top-left, matching bg-glow-tl).

tokens.name: lens-specular-opacity
tokens.usage: Opacity of the specular rim highlight blended over a lens.
